curvature_flow — SEGMENTATION contour op

• Data kinds: mask → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.curvature_flow(phi, *, t_end: 'float' = 50.0, dt: 'float' = 0.2, eta: 'float' = 1e-08, record_every: 'int' = 0) -> 'Dict[str, object]' (to call the implementation directly, import segcontour; segcontour.curvature_flow(phi, *, t_end: 'float' = 50.0, dt: 'float' = 0.2, eta: 'float' = 1e-08, record_every: 'int' = 0) -> 'Dict[str, object]'; from the registry, opssegmentation.get("curvature_flow"))

Usage

Level-set form of mean curvature flow (curve-shortening flow) φ_t = |∇φ| div(∇φ/|∇φ|) (inside where φ < 0; shrinks from the convex parts) (curvature_flow).

Explicit central differences: φ_t = (φ_xx φ_y² − 2 φ_x φ_y φ_xy + φ_yy φ_x²) / (φ_x² + φ_y² + η), step dt ≤ 0.25 (stability condition). phi = φ or a bool mask (converted to a signed distance). The area at each step is the sum of clip(0.5 − φ/|∇φ|, 0, 1).

Gate: the area enclosed by a simple closed curve obeys dA/dt = −∮ κ ds = −2π (winding number 1, even if not convex). For a circle r(t)² = r0² − 2t.

Returns: phi, mask, times, areas, area_rate (least-squares slope of area vs time), area_rate_theory = −2π, history (masks every record_every steps), n_steps.
